name: Dipole Labs
description: 为AI数据中心开发高速光学网络硬件，通过跳过光电转换让数据直接以光的形式传输，解决GPU集群因数据传输等待而浪费计算时间的问题，提高能源效率
description_en: Builds optical switches for AI data centers that skip light-to-electricity conversion, allowing data to stay as light and go directly where needed, solving GPU cluster compute time waste from data movement between chips
why_matters: 入选YC近期批次；解决AI数据中心网络层的核心瓶颈问题，通过光学交换技术减少GPU集群因数据传输等待造成的算力浪费，在GPU昂贵且数据中心追求算力最大化的时代具有重要意义
why_matters_en: Addresses a core networking bottleneck in AI data centers by eliminating light-to-electricity conversion waste, helping expensive GPU clusters avoid idle compute time during data movement, a timely problem as data centers seek maximum utilization of costly compute hardware
latest_news: 2026年9月13日，TechCrunch将其列为本届YC Demo Day投资人关注的项目之一。
latest_news_en: Included in TechCrunch’s September 13, 2026 roundup of startups attracting investor attention at the latest YC Demo Day.
source_title: The 9 buzziest startups from Y Combinator’s latest Demo Day, according to VCs

name: Praxis AI
description: 与企业合作收集人类工作的视频和数据，将其转化为训练机器人的材料，已在超150种不同环境中捕获视频数据，并与上市公司合作
description_en: Collects videos and data of humans doing work in partnership with businesses, turning them into training material for companies building robots, already working with publicly traded companies and captured video data in more than 150 different environments
why_matters: 入选YC近期批次；已与上市公司合作并在超过150种不同环境中收集训练数据，在企业开始尝试区分人类和机器人最适合的任务时，为机器人训练提供关键的真实世界数据基础
why_matters_en: Already working with publicly traded companies and captured data in over 150 environments, providing critical real-world training data as businesses experiment with task allocation between humans and robots during AI refinement phase
